prompt: In the style of an oil painting, a vibrant beach volleyball tournament unfolds under a bright sky. On the left side of the court stands a tall woman in a blue bikini, her arm raised high to spike the ball. Next to her, a man in yellow shorts crouches low, ready to receive. In the center of the sandy expanse, a referee in a striped shirt watches intently, his hand pointing toward the sideline. A white volleyball hovers mid-air above the net, caught in a moment of suspended motion. On the right side, a player in green trunks leaps desperately, his eyes fixed on the approaching sphere. Behind him, a spectator in a wide-brimmed hat sits on a folding chair, shielding her face from the sun. Beside that chair, a brown dog lies asleep on a towel, oblivious to the game. Near the dog, a red cooler rests on the sand, its lid slightly ajar. A child in a pink swimsuit runs past the cooler, chasing a seagull that flies low over the crowd. The seagull wings away from a man eating a sandwich, who looks up in surprise. Next to the eater, a woman applies sunscreen to her shoulder, her bottle held firmly in one hand. A boy in orange goggles stands nearby, holding a shovel and looking at the hole he just dug. Behind the boy, a couple shares an umbrella, their heads close together as they whisper. The man in the couple wears sunglasses, while the woman holds a cold drink. At the edge of the scene, a lifeguard in red shorts stands atop a wooden tower, scanning the horizon. Below the tower, a teenager ties his shoelaces, kneeling on the warm grains. A stray frisbee lies forgotten near the teenager, half-buried in the sand. Finally, a camera on a tripod captures the action from the sidelines, its lens pointed directly at the net. There is no scoreboard visible in the background. There is no water or ocean in sight. There is no shadow cast by the players.
